## Details

<a id="prot_key_yamo"></a>
### [`prot_key_yamo`](../../../../src/protection/protection_key_page.asm#L12) `$CF79`

*data*

Protection key, first half ($CF79-$CF98). Each check XORs a byte here with the byte $20 higher (second half, $CF99-$CFB8) and treats a zero result as a failed check. In the first 16 bytes of the two halves 15 pairs differ and one is equal ($CF83 = $CFA3 = $A2); the checked pairs ($CF79-$CF7B, $CF7E, $CF81) differ, so their XORs are nonzero. When a check fails, the checking code increments the low bytes of its own LDA/EOR operands, so a failed check moves on to the next pair: the reachable bytes are $CF79-$CF9A and $CF99-$CFBA. prot_key_yamo: XOR with prot_key_yamo_pair in spawn_yamo_protection_xor (Yamo enters the room) gives protection_result ($89).

- **Read by:** [`spawn_yamo`](../actor/actor_spawn.md#spawn_yamo)

<a id="prot_signature_a"></a>
### [`prot_signature_a`](../../../../src/protection/protection_key_page.asm#L26) `$CF8F`

*data*

Signature B9 B4 B4 ($CF8F-$CF91), equal to prot_signature_b. title_protection_check XORs the six signature bytes and needs zero; build_contact_masks loops for ever unless prot_signature_a = $B9 and prot_signature_b = prot_signature_a.

- **Read by:** [`show_title_screen`](../game/title_demo_start.md#show_title_screen), [`build_contact_masks`](../actor/frame_builder.md#build_contact_masks)

<a id="prot_key_yamo_pair"></a>
### [`prot_key_yamo_pair`](../../../../src/protection/protection_key_page.asm#L34) `$CF99`

*data*

Protection key, second half ($CF99-$CFB8, plus $CFB9-$CFBA that a moved check can reach). The bytes from $CFA9 on repeat the first half; of $CF99-$CFA8 only $CFA3 equals its partner $CF83.
